svg.title: Tech stack
svg.desc: Frontend: React, Next.js, Nuxt, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux. Mobile & desktop: React Native, Flutter, Electron. Backend: Node.js, NestJS, Express, Laravel, Django, Python, PHP. Data: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Supabase, Redis, Prisma. Commerce & CMS: Shopify, WooCommerce, WordPress, Webflow, Strapi. Cloud & DevOps: AWS, Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare, Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions. AI & automation: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, n8n, Make, Zapier.
